newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Euroairport cargo traffic up 14pct Jan-Nov 96.
newsitem.headline: Euroairport cargo traffic up 14pct Jan-Nov 96.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Basle-Mulhouse-Freiburg airport, situated on the French-Swiss border, in the first 11 months of 1996 totalled 81,059 tonnes, an increase of 14 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.
Airfreight traffic handled at the airport, officially known as EuroAirport, totalled 45,342 tonnes, an increase of 28 percent on 1995 11-month levels.
Airfreight carried on scheduled full-freighter services increased by 45 percent to 29,653 tonnes, the airport authority added.
Express airfreight increased by eight percent on 1995 levels to 11,939 tonnes.
Trucked airfreight traffic was stable on the previous year's levels at 35,717 tonnes.
Postal traffic totalled 3,000 tonnes, up seven percent on the first 11 months of 1995.
